# Indikator 10

Indikator 10 is one of eleven quality indicators tracked in the Danish ADHD-databasen (ADHD Database), the nationwide registry covering children, adolescents, and adults diagnosed with ADHD. Specifically, Indikator 10 measures the proportion of treatment courses among **adults** in which the patient's social support needs were assessed no later than 120 days after the start of treatment [^src1] [^src2]. It belongs to a cluster of indicators (Indikator 8 through 11) introduced for adult ADHD patients, and 2024–2025 marks the first year this patient group and these specific indicators have been reported — meaning there is no historical trend data to compare against yet [^src1].

For the reporting period 01.04.2024 – 31.03.2025, national performance on Indikator 10 stood at 37% (confidence interval 35–38%) [^src1] [^src2]. This falls far short of the development target of ≥90% set for the indicator [^src2]. Regional results varied widely, ranging from a low of 14% in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] to a high of 52% in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] [^src2]. The other regions posted: [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] 49% (151/311) [^src2] [^src3], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] 37% (42/114) [^src2], and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] 23% (259/1.110) [^src2]. Notably, Region Hovedstaden's 49% result places it above the national average of 37% [^src3]. No region reached the 90% development target [^src2], though among departments with more than three patients, one — PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser - Horsens — achieved 97%, meeting the goal [^src2]. At the other extreme, six departments (eight if private hospitals are included) reported 0% [^src2].

The steering group behind the ADHD Database discussed possible explanations for the low overall performance. A significant factor appears to be registration practice: assessments of social support needs are often recorded in a way that the database does not capture, artificially depressing the indicator's apparent results [^src2]. The group also noted that a non-trivial number of treatment courses are reported from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics, raising the question of whether these should be excluded from the adult population used to calculate the indicator [^src2]. Separately, the near-total absence of reported courses from private hospitals makes it impossible to assess whether those providers meet the quality indicators at all [^src2]. As a result, the steering group agreed that regional and other stakeholder representatives would work on improving registration practice going forward [^src2], and decided that the indicator itself would be retained [^src2].

Indikator 10 is registered within the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]], the same national database that tracks related indicators such as [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]], [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]], and [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] for the adult ADHD population [^src1].

## Claims

**Observation**
- Indikator 8-11 vedrører voksne med en ADHD-diagnose. Det er første gang denne patientgruppe og tilhørende indikatorer og resultaterne præsenteres derfor uden historik [^src1] (indikator-8, indikator-9, indikator-10, indikator-11)
- Dette er første gang, der registreres data på indikatoren omhandlende vurdering af sociale støttebehov [^src1] (indikator-10)
- Et ikke-ubetydeligt antal forløb indrapporteres fra børne- og ungdomspsykiatriske ambulatorier, og det drøftes i styregruppen om disse skal udgå fra voksenpopulationen [^src1] (indikator-10)
- Det næsten ikkeeksisterende antal forløb indrapporteret fra privathospitaler gør det ikke muligt at vurdere om de lever op til kvalitetsindikatorerne [^src1] (privathospitaler, indikator-10)

**Performance**
- Indikator 10 opfyldelse var 37 (35-38) % for perioden 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025 [^src1] (indikator-10)
- På landsplan er 37 % af de voksne ADHD-patienters sociale støttebehov blevet vurderet indenfor tidsfristen [^src1] (danmark, indikator-10)
- De regionale resultater for Indikator 10 varierer fra 14 % i Nordjylland til 52 % i Midtjylland [^src1] (region-nordjylland, region-midtjylland, indikator-10)
- Der er ingen regioner der nåede udviklingsmålet på 90 % for Indikator 10 [^src1] (indikator-10)
- Blandt afdelinger med mere end tre patienter er der én der har nået udviklingsmålet: PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser - Horsens (97 %) [^src1] (pho-klinik-1-horsens, indikator-10)
- Der er seks afdelinger med et resultat på 0 % for Indikator 10 (otte hvis privathospitalerne tælles med) [^src1] (indikator-10)
- Region Hovedstaden ligger med 49% over landsgennemsnittet for indikator 10 [^src1] (region-hovedstaden, indikator-10)

**Quality-indicator**
- Indikator 10 måler andelen af behandlingsforløb blandt voksne, hvor patientens sociale støttebehov er vurderet senest 120 dage efter behandlingsstart [^src1] (indikator-10)

**Quality-target**
- Udviklingmålet for Indikator 10 er ≥ 90 % [^src1] (indikator-10)

**Clinical-rationale**
- Den lave opfyldelsesgrad for Indikator 10 delvist forklares ved registreringspraksis, da vurderingen oftest registreres på en måde, der ikke opfanges i databasen [^src1] (indikator-10)

**Decision**
- Styregruppen aftaler at repræsentanterne for de enkelte regioner og aktører går tilbage og arbejder på bedre registreringspraksis [^src1] (indikator-10)
- Indikatoren bibeholdes [^src1] (indikator-10)
